# AGENTS.md
## First read - Treat `settings.gradle` as the source of truth for modules. The root `README.MD` still mentions a `config` module that is not included anymore. - This is a Java 21 multi-project Gradle build with `common`, platform adapters (`paper`, `jda`, `hytale`), and runnable examples under `examples/*`.
## Architecture that matters - `common/` is the real core: platform-agnostic configuration readers, text utilities, and the full persistence stack live here. - Platform modules are discovered through `ServiceLoader`; see `platforms/paper/src/main/resources/META-INF/services/fr.ibrakash.helper.platform.KashPlatform` and the JDA equivalent. - A Paper plugin should resolve the platform and register an addon (`examples/paper/src/main/java/fr/ibrakash/helper/example/ExamplePlugin.java`); that unlocks `paths()` and `configurations()`. - JDA is different on purpose: do **not** call `KashPlatform.registerAddon`. Subclass `KashJdaAddon` instead and let its constructor bootstrap config, JDA, slash commands, console, logging, and shutdown hooks (`platforms/jda/.../KashJdaAddon.java`). - `Configurations.loadReadOnlyNode(...)` merges only missing keys from bundled resources and stores default hashes in `.defaults/*.sha256`; preserve that behavior when changing config loading. - Small typed readers are the normal config pattern: `ExampleLocale`, `ExampleItems`, `ExampleMenus`, `JdaEmbedConfigurationLocale`, `JdaSystemLocale`.
## Persistence model - Runtime backend selection is config-driven through `ConfigPersistence.orderedTypes()` and `PersistenceManager.create(...)`; JSON, SQL, then Mongo fallbacks are normal. - Prefer the annotation-driven `EntityStore`/`PersistenceSession` path for new repositories when the entity model is enough; `examples/paper/.../HomeRepository.java` is the clearest example. - Use `DatabaseRepository` only when you need its cache-oriented builder APIs, lazy adapter activation, ranking, or partial column loads; `ExampleRepository` demonstrates the intended style. - Entity shape is declared with annotations, not handwritten SQL: see `ExampleData` for `@PersistedEmbedded`, relations, blobs, and ranks. - Embedded fields include inherited columns; the regression contract is in `common/src/test/.../EntityModelEmbeddedInheritanceTest.java`. - Persistence runtime libraries are **not** bundled by `common`; consumer/plugin runtimes must supply Jackson/Hikari/driver libs as needed (documented in `README.MD` and `plugin.yml`).
## Platform-specific patterns - Paper contributes serializers and blob serializers centrally in `KashPaperPlatform` (e.g. `World`, `Sound`, `ItemStack`); add platform serializers there, not ad hoc in feature code. - The Paper example keeps user-editable locale/item/menu defaults in resources (`locale.yml`, `items.yml`, `menus.yml`), but `config.yml` and `persistence.yml` are created from typed objects via `serializedConfig(...)`. - JDA embed content is configuration-driven. `examples/jda/src/main/resources/example-jda-locale.xml` shows the supported pseudo-XML tags parsed by `PersistentEmbedParser`. - Persistent embed component handlers are keyed as `embedPath:componentId` inside `PersistentEmbedManager`; keep component IDs stable across reloads. - Slash commands are uploaded by `JdaSlashCommandManager`; `devGuildId` in `ExampleJdaConfig` switches registration from global to guild-scoped for faster iteration. - `platforms/hytale` is currently a stub; do not assume the Hytale example reflects the same completeness as Paper/JDA.
## Verified workflows - `./gradlew testsQuick` — quick smoke path; currently runs `:kash-helper-common:persistenceSmokeTests` and compiles the Paper example. - `./gradlew testsAll` — main verification aggregate for `common`, `paper`, and `jda`. - `./gradlew :kash-helper-jda:test` — focused JDA parser/config tests. - `./gradlew :kash-helper-jda:example:runExample` — runs the bot from `examples/jda/run`. - `./gradlew :kash-helper-paper:example:build` — builds the Paper example jar. - `./gradlew :kash-helper-paper:example:devPaperExampleJar` — copies the shadow jar into `examples/paper/run/plugins` for local server trials.
## Editing guidance - Keep package names under `fr.ibrakash.helper...`; examples mirror the target platform package structure. - Follow existing snake_case persistence column names and explicit annotation values instead of inferring names implicitly. - When adding config-backed features, prefer adding a tiny typed reader/object plus resource defaults over manual YAML traversal. - When documenting or scripting module paths, use Gradle project IDs from `settings.gradle` (`:kash-helper-paper`, `:kash-helper-jda:example`, etc.).
